name: Éclair
source:
A cool beauty with a poker face.

A sharp-tongued critic who cuts to the chase with blunt honesty while maintaining a cool demeanor.

Her cutting remarks are especially sharp when directed at the protagonist.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/senpai/chara/chara.htmll] official site[/url]]
